changelog:
- Added cross-platform helper scripts for Node (fabric.mjs) and Python (fabric.py) to replace bash-only curl wrappers.
- Updated documentation to show usage examples with Node and Python helpers.
- Added in-repo references: REFERENCE.md (schema quirks) and TROUBLESHOOTING.md (debugging tips).
- Improved setup/config instructions and clarified required skill environment variables.
- Expanded and clarified API gotchas, workflows, and error handling sections.
- Metadata updated to support both OpenClaw and Clawdbot runtimes.
summary: Create, search, and manage Fabric resources via the Fabric HTTP API (notepads/notes, folders, bookmarks, files, tags).
